theorems.name: Submission.p04_tia_cohomology_transfer
theorems.statement: ∀ {k G : Type _} [CommRing k] [Group G] [Fintype G] (A : Rep k G) (H : Subgroup G) [Fintype H] (n : ℕ), ∃ R : groupCohomology A n →ₗ[k] groupCohomology (Rep.res H.subtype A) n, ∃ C : groupCohomology (Rep.res H.subtype A) n →ₗ[k] groupCohomology A n, ∀ x : groupCohomology A n, C (R x) = H.index • x
